title: 转机
goal: 会跟着指示牌转机，确认行李是否直挂，误机时会要求改签。
tips: 转机跟着 Transfers / Flight Connections 指示牌走，不要跟着 Exit / Baggage Claim 走。
值机时就问清楚：Is my bag checked through to ...? 直挂的行李中转站不用取。
layover = 中转停留时间。不同国家对过境签证要求不同，出发前查清楚。

exchanges.hearZh: 这是您的最终目的地吗？

exchanges.hear: Your bag is checked through to Berlin.
exchanges.reply: So I don't need to pick it up here?
exchanges.replyZh: 所以我在这里不用取行李？

exchanges.hear: Follow the signs for Flight Connections.
exchanges.reply: Do I need to go through security again?
exchanges.replyZh: 我需要再过一次安检吗？

exchanges.hear: I'm afraid you've missed your connecting flight.
exchanges.hearZh: 恐怕您已经错过了转乘航班。
exchanges.reply: Can you rebook me on the next flight?
exchanges.replyZh: 您能帮我改签到下一班吗？

exchanges.hear: The next flight is tomorrow morning.
exchanges.reply: Will the airline provide a hotel?
exchanges.replyZh: 航空公司会提供酒店吗？

exchanges.hear: Your connecting flight leaves from Terminal five.
exchanges.hearZh: 您的转乘航班从5号航站楼出发。
exchanges.reply: How do I get to Terminal five?

exchanges.hear: You need a transit visa to leave the airport.
exchanges.hearZh: 您需要过境签证才能出机场。
exchanges.reply: That's OK. I'll stay inside the airport.
exchanges.replyZh: 没关系，我就待在机场里。

dialogue.title: 误机后在转机柜台改签

lines.en: Excuse me. My first flight was delayed, and I missed my connecting flight.
lines.zh: 打扰一下。我的第一程航班延误了，我错过了转乘航班。

lines.en: I'm sorry to hear that. May I see your boarding pass?
lines.zh: 很遗憾。能看一下您的登机牌吗？

lines.en: Here you are. I was going to Madrid.
lines.zh: 给您。我本来要去马德里。

lines.en: Let me check. The next flight to Madrid leaves at six fifteen this evening.
lines.zh: 我查一下。下一班去马德里的航班是今晚六点十五分。

lines.en: Can you rebook me on that flight?
lines.zh: 您能帮我改签到那一班吗？

lines.en: Yes. Here's your new boarding pass. Your bag will go on the same flight.
lines.zh: 可以。这是您的新登机牌。您的行李也会上同一班飞机。

lines.en: Great. Do I need to go through security again?
lines.zh: 太好了。我需要再过一次安检吗？

lines.en: Yes. Follow the signs for Flight Connections.
lines.zh: 需要。跟着“转机”指示牌走。
